zh: 交替子串在每个位置上的字符只由下标奇偶决定，所以它一定与全局模板 0101… 或 1010… 之一在这一段上完全一致。
固定一个模板，把一段改成交替所需的翻转次数，就是该段内与模板不一致的位置数；问题变成“不一致数不超过 k 的最长窗口”。
对两种模板各做一次滑动窗口：右端加入时若 s[r] 与 (r+start)%2 不同则 bad 加 1；当 bad>k 时移出左端（它不一致则 bad 减 1）并让 left 加 1；每步用 r−left+1 更新答案。
en: In an alternating substring, the character at each position is determined by the index parity, so the substring agrees completely with one of the global templates 0101... or 1010... on that range.

With a template fixed, the number of flips needed to make a range alternating is the number of positions in it that differ from the template; the task becomes the longest window with at most k mismatches.

Run a sliding window once per template: when the right end enters, bad += 1 if s[r] differs from (r + start) % 2; while bad > k, remove the left end (bad -= 1 if it was a mismatch) and advance left; update the answer with r - left + 1 at every step.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Match against the global templates 0101... and 1010... separately, and use a sliding window that keeps the number of mismatched positions in the window at most k.

## Proof of correctness

Every alternating substring agrees with one of these two global templates, and the cost of creating it is exactly the number of mismatches. For a fixed template, enlarging the window never decreases the cost, and when the budget is exceeded the left end shrinks; the two pointers find the longest feasible window for every right end, and the larger result of the two templates is the answer.

## Complexity

Time O(n), auxiliary space O(1).
